# Phuc Bui — Frontend Engineer

Personal portfolio of Phuc Bui, a Frontend Engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City.

## About

Phuc Bui builds motion-rich websites and web applications. He runs Perxel Studio and is building OpenWallet. Specializes in GSAP animations, Next.js, and modern frontend development.
